MKS는 일본 사이타마현 도코로자와의 미카시마 제작소(三ヶ島製作所)가 만: MKS is the pedal brand of Mikashima Industrial (三ヶ島製作所) in Tokorozawa, Saitama, Japan. Founded in 1943 as an aircraft component maker, the company switched to bicycle pedals in 1946 and was incorporated in 1949. To this day it makes its pedals end to end in its own factory: forging, pressing, machining, heat treatment and assembly.
자전거 페달 생산을 시작한 해: The year MKS began making bicycle pedals
일본 경륜(케이린)에서 인증받은 유일한 페달 제조사: The only pedal maker approved for Japanese keirin
일본 경륜에서는 엄격한 기준을 통과해 NJS 인증을 받은 부품만 쓸 수: Japanese keirin allows only parts that pass strict standards and carry NJS approval, and MKS is currently the only approved maker of keirin pedals. The precision built up in racers’ pedals carries straight through to touring pedals and city flat pedals.
페달의 심장인 스핀들은 모두 자체 공장에서 냉간 단조로 만들고, 자체 열: Every spindle, the heart of the pedal, is cold-forged in our own factory, then heat-treated in-house for a hard surface and a tough core.
숙련된 기술자가 컵 앤 콘 베어링을 하나하나 손으로 조정합니다. NJS: Skilled technicians adjust every cup-and-cone bearing by hand. Top NJS-approved models are set up with spacers as thin as 0.03 mm.
프로 경륜 선수 약 2,400명의 발밑을 지키는 페달. NJS 인증을 받: Pedals under the feet of some 2,400 professional keirin racers. MKS is currently the only NJS-approved keirin pedal.
흔히 쓰는 ADC12보다 성형이 어렵지만 충격과 부식에 강한 ADC6 알: Bodies are die-cast in ADC6 aluminium, harder to form than the common ADC12 but more resistant to impact and corrosion.
“남이 뭐라 하든, 좋은 제품을 만들면 된다.” 회장이 즐겨 말하는 MK: “We just had to make good products, regardless of what other people say.” That is how the chairman likes to describe where MKS began.
MKS는 창업 이래 오기노(荻野) 가문이 이끌어 온 회사입니다. 1946: MKS has been led by the Ogino family since its founding. In 1946 there were an estimated 40 pedal makers in Japan; only two remain today, and MKS is one of them. The forging, heat treatment and assembly skills built on pedals now also serve automotive parts production.

Lambda is a double-sided platform pedal that supports the whole sole of the foot. Rows of studs line its wide cage, so even on long rides in regular shoes without clips, the foot stays planted.

도시 라이딩을 위한 플랫폼 페달. 미니벨로와 시티 바이크에 깔끔하게 어울: A platform pedal for city riding. Looks clean on minivelos and city bikes.
클래식한 실루엣의 알루미늄 플랫폼 페달. 일상 자전거와 투어링 자전거에: An aluminium platform pedal with a classic silhouette. Suits everyday and touring bikes.

EZY는 MKS가 직접 만든 페달 탈착 시스템입니다. 크랭크에 전용 어댑: EZY is MKS’s own detachable pedal system. Fit the dedicated adapter to the crank once, and from then on the pedal comes off and goes back on by hand, without tools. There are two versions: the original Ezy and the further developed Ezy Superior.
접이식 자전거를 더 작게 접을 때, 자전거를 기차나 자동차에 실을 때,: When folding a bike smaller, taking it on a train or in a car, or storing it in a narrow hallway or on a wall, the pedals are no longer in the way. Many models, including Sylvan, Lambda and Allways, come in EZY versions.
